# TheSeoSoul
> Free technical SEO + GEO audit with shareable report URLs. Honest free tier — no invented Domain Authority or traffic charts.

## Site
- Homepage: https://theseosoul.com/
- Free tools: https://theseosoul.com/tools
- About: https://theseosoul.com/about
- Contact: https://theseosoul.com/contact
- Privacy: https://theseosoul.com/privacy
- Terms: https://theseosoul.com/terms

## Primary product
- Full technical SEO audit (paste any public URL): https://theseosoul.com/#home-audit-url
- Shareable reports live at /audit/[domain]. Most reports are noindex; only curated examples are listed in the sitemap.
